mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases by more than 2% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3%, the combined signal of tight monetary policy and high inflation leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with high inflation
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.5% MoM and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease, the combined signal of labor market weakness leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE MoM increase > 0.5% and PAYEMS decrease
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM and PAYEMS decreases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a potential supply chain disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases by more than 1% MoM during late-cycle expansion and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.
